# Vietnamese Lunar Calendar

> Vietnamese lunar dates in GMT+7, displayed in Vietnamese or English. One daily event includes the lunar date and selected observances.

- [Vietnamese guide](README.md)
- [English guide](README.en.md)
- [Holiday catalog](docs/HOLIDAYS.md)
- [Operations](docs/OPERATIONS.md)
- [Automation](docs/AUTOMATION.md)
- [Security](SECURITY.md)

Default subscriptions: output/viet_lunar_latest.ics and output/viet_lunar_en_latest.ics. Both cover the current year and next year. Personal dates stay in ignored local files. Observances are not statutory leave schedules. No web server or AI runtime is required.
